gloss: game record (shogi, go, chess); score sheet of a board game

definitions.gloss: game record (of shogi, go, or chess); notation of moves
definitions.explanation: A written or digital record of the moves played in a game of shogi, go, or (less often) chess. Kept for later study and analysis, and a central part of how professional and amateur players learn. Published for major professional matches in magazines, newspapers, and online databases.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{棋譜|きふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べて→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。

notes:
Compound of {棋|き} ('board game', especially shogi, go, and chess) and {譜|ふ} ('record; score; notation' — the same character used in ⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧, 'sheet music'). Both elements are literary kanji rarely used outside such compounds.

USAGE:
- A specialized but standard term among shogi and go players; almost every serious player reads {棋譜|きふ}.
- The verbs used with {棋譜|きふ} reflect how records are handled:
  - {棋譜|きふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to record the moves as a game is played.
  - {棋譜|きふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to reproduce/play through a recorded game on a board.
  - {棋譜|きふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a game record (for posterity).
- Note the homophone ⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧ ('donation') — context and kanji distinguish them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {棋譜|きふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to record a game
- {棋譜|きふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to play through a game record
- {棋譜|きふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a record of the game
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{棋譜|きふ}: professional game records
- {棋譜|きふ}⟦{解析|かいせき}→解析：16075_kaiseki⟧: game record analysis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧: sheet music — uses the same {譜|ふ} element; 'score' in the musical sense.
- ⟦{譜面|ふめん}→譜面：11103_fumen⟧: score; notation — general term for written records of music; shares the 'notation' sense.
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: record — generic word for any record; {棋譜|きふ} is a specific kind of ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧.
- ⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧: donation — a homophone with different kanji; easy to confuse in speech.
